test_title: PYST 57: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 09 Sept, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Airports play a vital role in improving regional connectivity. Which scheme promotes affordable air travel to under-served and unserved airports?
solution:
The correct answer is __**UDAN**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **UDAN** (Ude Desh ka Aam Nagrik) is a flagship regional connectivity scheme launched by the Ministry of Civil Aviation, Government of India, in April 2017.
 
• The primary goal of UDAN is to make air travel affordable and accessible to the common citizens, especially in remote and regional areas, by connecting unserved and under-served airports.
 
• The scheme is part of the **National Civil Aviation Policy (NCAP)**, 2016, and provides incentives to airlines to operate flights on regional routes.
 
• UDAN is implemented through a **Viability Gap Funding (VGF)** mechanism to financially support airlines in maintaining operations on unprofitable routes.
 
• As of 2023, UDAN has successfully connected numerous airports across India, significantly boosting regional connectivity and contributing to economic growth in smaller towns and cities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **UDAY** (Ujwal DISCOM Assurance Yojana):

 
 
• UDAY is a government scheme launched in November 2015 to improve the financial health and operational efficiency of state-owned power distribution companies (DISCOMs).
 
• It aims to reduce the financial losses of DISCOMs by restructuring their debts and implementing operational improvements like reducing Aggregate Technical & Commercial (AT&C) losses.
 
• It does not relate to air travel or regional connectivity.
 
 
 
• **PM Gati Shakti**:
 
 
• PM Gati Shakti is a National Master Plan for multi-modal connectivity launched in 2021 by the Government of India.
 
• Its objective is to integrate infrastructure development across various sectors, including railways, roads, ports, and logistics, to reduce logistics costs and improve efficiency.
 
• While it encompasses aviation infrastructure, its scope is broader and not specifically focused on affordable air travel.
 
 
 
• **Sagarmala**:
 
 
• The Sagarmala Programme, launched in 2015, focuses on port-led development and modernization of ports to enhance maritime logistics and coastal community development in India.
 
• It aims to harness India’s coastline and waterways for economic growth but is unrelated to air travel or airport connectivity.
